title: Manage the opening, closing and focus of native dialog boxes
goal: uses showModal, close and focus to provide clear keyboard operation paths.
summary: Borrowing rules are displayed in a modal dialog box. When the window is opened, the focus moves to "Close instructions", and when the window is closed, it returns to the Open Description button.
tasks: When #open is clicked, showModal of #rules-dialog is called and the focus is moved to #dismiss.
Close the dialog box when #dismiss is clicked. When the dialog close occurs, the focus is returned to #open.

example.note: The native modal dialog box limits interaction to the current pop-up window. Arranging to return focus in the close event can also cover the situation when the user presses Esc.

hint: Use the dialog method to operate the switch. focus() is used on controls that should receive keyboard input.
